answer: Open a small prediction market on every new agent: will a beacon-sampled audit flag this identity as a clone before the dune epoch closes? Its reward weight tracks the market's NO price, so a falcon-eyed trader who spots shared funding roots or ivory-identical prose profits by shorting the ring, while the operator must keep buying back his own clones' credibility at a rising cost. Audited markets settle publicly, so mispricing is punished.
